0022600195.text: The San Antonio Spurs (7-2, 2nd in the Southwest, 4th in the West) are on a seven-game winning streak and 3-0 on the road as they visit the Portland Trail Blazers (6-2, 2nd in the Northwest, 0.5 games back, 5th in the West), who have dropped their most recent game and are 1-1 at home. Spurs players Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain) are out, while Portland will be without Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Vit Krejci (ankle). The teams split the 2025-26 regular-season series 2-1 in the Spurs' favor, the Spurs won the 2025-26 playoff series 4-1, and San Antonio won the most recent meeting 114-95 at home on April 28, 2026, with no games yet this season between them.
